arxiv-2104-10625.title: Searching to Sparsify Tensor Decomposition for N-ary Relational Data
arxiv-2104-10625.creator: Shimin DI, Quanming YAO ∗, Lei CHEN
arxiv-2104-10625.description: Abstract . Tensor, an extension of the vector and matrix to the multi-dimensional case, is a natural way to describe the N-ary relational data. Recently, tensor decomposition methods have been introduced into N-ary relational data and become state-of-the-art on embedding learning. However, the performance of existing tensor decomposition methods is not as good as desired.

arxiv-2105-07592.title: Dermoscopic Image Classification with Neural Style Transfer
arxiv-2105-07592.creator: Yutong Li, Ruoqing Zhu, Annie Qu, Mike Yeh
arxiv-2105-07592.description: Abstract Skin cancer, the most commonly found human malignancy, is primarily diagnosed visually via dermoscopic analysis, biopsy and histopathological examination. However, unlike other types of cancer, automated image classification of skin lesions is deemed more challenging due to the irregularity and variability in the lesions’ appearances.

arxiv-2109-03707.title: Relative Cluster Categories and Higgs categories
arxiv-2109-03707.creator: Yilin Wu
arxiv-2109-03707.description: Abstract . Cluster categories were introduced in 2006 by Buan-Marsh-Reineke-Reiten-Todorov in order to categorify acyclic cluster algebras without coefficients. Their construction was generalized by Amiot (2009) and Plamondon (2011) to arbitrary cluster algebras associated with quivers. A higher dimensional generalization is due to Guo (2011).

arxiv-2403-19624.title: Ghost cycles exhibit increased entrainment and richer dynamics in response to external forcing compared to slow-fast systems
arxiv-2403-19624.creator: Daniel Koch, Aneta Koseska
arxiv-2403-19624.description: Abstract Many natural, living and engineered systems display oscillations that are characterized by multiple timescales. Typically, such systems are described as slow-fast systems, where the slow dynamics result from a hyperbolic slow manifold that guides the movement of the system trajectories.

arxiv-2404-12565.title: Limits on Inferring T-cell Specificity from Partial Information
arxiv-2404-12565.creator: James Henderson, Yuta Nagano, Martina Milighetti, Andreas Tiffeau-Mayer
arxiv-2404-12565.description: Abstract A key challenge in molecular biology is to decipher the mapping of protein sequence to function. To perform this mapping requires the identification of sequence features most informative about function. Here, we quantify the amount of information (in bits) that T-cell receptor (TCR) sequence features provide about antigen specificity.

arxiv-2508-14562.title: Locality-aware Concept Bottleneck Model
arxiv-2508-14562.creator: Sujin Jeon, Hyundo Lee, Eungseo Kim, Sanghack Lee, Byoung-Tak Zhang, illhyhl1111@snu.ac.kr, juniormoo@snu.ac.kr, btzhang@bi.snu.ac.kr, Inwoo Hwang
arxiv-2508-14562.description: Abstract Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) are inherently interpretable models that make predictions based on human-understandable visual cues, referred to as concepts . As obtaining dense concept annotations with human labeling is demanding and costly, recent approaches utilize foundation models to determine the concepts existing in the images.

europmc-pmc5489418.title: Hand classification of fMRI ICA noise components.
europmc-pmc5489418.creator: Griffanti L, Douaud G, Bijsterbosch J, Evangelisti S, Alfaro-Almagro F, Glasser MF, Duff EP, Fitzgibbon S, Westphal R, Carone D, Beckmann CF, Smith SM.
europmc-pmc5489418.description: We present a practical "how-to" guide to help determine whether single-subject fMRI independent components (ICs) characterise structured noise or not. pmc-10497526.title: Spatial distribution characteristics and causes of public sports venues in China
pmc-10497526.creator: Yueting Zhang, Yikeranmu Yi Ming, Bing Shi
pmc-10497526.description: Public sports venues serve as a crucial material medium for human athletic activities. Research on their spatial distribution holds profound implications for optimizing spatial layout and promoting human sports endeavors. This paper takes interest points of sports venues in China as research samples, employing GIS spatial analysis tools, mathematical statistics, and Geo-detector as research methods.

pmc-10701937.title: Womandla Health: development and rationale of a behavioral intervention to support HIV treatment adherence among postpartum women in South Africa
pmc-10701937.creator: Jennifer A. Pellowski, Destry Jensen, Nokwazi Tsawe, Christopher Colvin, Susan Cu-Uvin, Don Operario, Mark Lurie, Abigail Harrison, Landon Myer, Lucia Knight
pmc-10701937.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundWhile Option B + has made great strides in eliminating vertical transmission of HIV and improving access to lifelong antiretroviral therapy (ART) for women, the postpartum period remains a risk period for disengagement from HIV care and non-adherence.MethodsLongitudinal qualitative data was collected from 30 women living with HIV in Cape Town, South Africa from pregnancy through 1 year postpartum to examine key barriers and facilitators to HIV treatment adherence across this transition.

pmc-11323604.title: Lesson on obesity and anatomy of adipose tissue: new models of study in the era of clinical and translational research
pmc-11323604.creator: Tonia Luca, Salvatore Pezzino, Stefano Puleo, Sergio Castorina
pmc-11323604.description: Obesity is a serious global illness that is frequently associated with metabolic syndrome. Adipocytes are the typical cells of adipose organ, which is composed of at least two different tissues, white and brown adipose tissue. They functionally cooperate, interconverting each other under physiological conditions, but differ in their anatomy, physiology, and endocrine functions.

pmc-11532811.title: Associations of HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) indication, HIV risk perception and unwillingness to use PrEP among people who inject drugs in Baltimore, MD
pmc-11532811.creator: Tarfa Verinumbe, Gregory M Lucas, Katie Zook, Brian Weir, Miles Landry, Kathleen R Page, Susan G Sherman, Oluwaseun Falade-Nwulia
pmc-11532811.description: BackgroundPerceived HIV risk may impact willingness to initiate PrEP among people who inject drugs (PWID).MethodsWe analyzed baseline data from PrEP eligible PWID in Baltimore, MD. Risk perception was assessed by PWID relative to the average risk of their age group categorized as: higher-than, lower-than, or about average.

pmc-11590635.creator: Jing Yu, Chen Cui, Kai Ma, Peng Yang, Yizhou Jiang, Xiaoyong Wang
pmc-11590635.description: BackgroundCurrently, Vonoprazan (VPZ) and amoxicillin dual regimen (VA-dual) has not achieved satisfied efficacy as the first-line treatment for Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection in China. Thus, we aimed to determine the effect of VA-dual plus Saccharomyces boulardii (S. boulardii) on H. pylori eradication rate.MethodsNaive H.

pmc-11704768.title: Factors associated with diabetes mellitus and hypertension among adults in the northern rural area, Afghanistan
pmc-11704768.creator: Said Hafizullah Fayaz, Nobuyuki Hamajima, Muhammad Kamel Frozanfar, Mohammad Hassan Hamrah, Souphalak Inthaphatha, Kimihiro Nishino, Eiko Yamamoto
pmc-11704768.description: Afghanistan has an increasing trend of mortality due to non-communicable diseases but most studies were conducted in urban areas. This study aimed to assess the prevalence and factors associated with diabetes mellitus and hypertension in a rural area in Afghanistan.

pmc-12609657.title: Lipoprotein(a) and Risk of Ischemic Stroke in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12609657.creator: Bartosz Maj, Michal Pruc, Karol Momot, Kamil Krauz, Joanna Kozak, Hieronim Golczyk, Julia Uminska, Katarzyna Kotfis, Łukasz Szpinda, Michal Lis, Frank W. Peacock, Lukasz Szarpak
pmc-12609657.description: Background/Objectives: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a significant contributor to ischemic stroke; however, existing thromboembolic risk scores exhibit only moderate predictive accuracy. Lipoprotein(a) (Lp(a)), a genetically determined lipoprotein characterized by proatherogenic and prothrombotic properties, may play a role in cardioembolic events in AF. Nonetheless, its clinical relevance in this context remains ambiguous.

pmc-12612194.title: A non-canonical lymphoblast in refractory childhood T-cell leukaemia
pmc-12612194.creator: Bram S. J. Lim, Holly J. Whitfield, Mi K. Trinh, Gianna Bloye, Rebecca Thomas, Nathaniel D. Anderson, Anna Wenger, Angus Hodder, Taryn D. Treger, Henry Lee-Six, Tim H. H. Coorens, Conor Parks, Toochi Ogbonnah, Petri Pölönen, Charles G. Mullighan, David T. Teachey, Jason Xu, Kai Tan, Melanie Hagleitn
pmc-12612194.description: Refractory cancers may arise either through the acquisition of resistance mechanisms or represent distinct disease states. The origin of childhood T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (T-ALL) that does not respond to initial treatment, i.e. refractory disease, is unknown. Refractory T-ALL carries a poor prognosis and cannot be predicted at diagnosis.

pmc-13137173.title: Beyond Liver Function Tests, Liver Stiffness, and Portal Pressure: Portal-Systemic Shunting as a New Endpoint for Clinical Trials of Cirrhosis and Portal Hypertension
pmc-13137173.creator: Andrew P. Keaveny, Kamran Qureshi, Stuart C. Gordon, Joanne C. Imperial, Michael P. McRae, Touraj Shokati, Gregory T. Everson
pmc-13137173.description: ASH).1 It was suggested that future trials in this population should be designed stratifying the presence of clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) defined by measuring the hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG). Because HVPG measurement is invasive and operator-dependent, noninvasive alternatives—such as combining liver stiffness measurement (LSM) with platelet count (PLT) using the Baveno criteria—have been proposed.

pmc-13200138.title: Active sensing during a visual perceptual decision-making task
pmc-13200138.creator: Naureen Ghani, Angela Yaxuan Yang, International Brain Laboratory
pmc-13200138.description: SummaryFrom the Welsh tidy mouse to the New York City pizza rat, movement reveals rodent intelligence. Rodents use self-generated movements to modulate sensory input in touch and audition, but whether this extends to vision is less established. Here, we show that some head-fixed mice developed an active sensing strategy in a visual perceptual decision-making task.

pmc-13413626.title: Impact of Moringa oleifera Leaf Powder Addition on the Properties of Cranberry‑Based Gummies and Marshmallows With Low‐Glycemic Sweeteners
pmc-13413626.creator: Lourdes Cervera‐Chiner, María Luisa Castelló, Francisco José García‐Mares, María Dolores Ortolá
pmc-13413626.description: Traditional sweets are associated with dental caries, high blood glucose, and obesity. This study evaluated the impact of incorporating Moringa oleifera leaf powder (MOLP) into soft candies (gummies and marshmallows) formulated with a fixed base matrix of cranberry juice and low‐glycemic, noncariogenic sweeteners (isomaltulose, oligofructose, and tagatose). MOLP was incorporated at 0%, 2.5%, 5.0%, and 7.
